WITH s1 AS (
  SELECT cr.raceId AS raceId, r.name AS name, AVG(cr.points) AS avgpts, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM constructorResults cr
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
  WHERE cr.points > 1.0
  GROUP BY cr.raceId, r.name
),
s2 AS (
  SELECT name, AVG(avgpts) AS avgavg
  FROM s1
  GROUP BY name
)
SELECT s1.raceId, s1.name, s1.avgpts, s1.cnt, s1.avgpts / s2.avgavg AS ratio
FROM s1
JOIN s2 ON s1.name = s2.name
ORDER BY (s1.avgpts / s2.avgavg) IS NULL, s1.avgpts / s2.avgavg DESC
LIMIT 10
